description: Animate an AvatarSay character avatar (ast_...) with lip-synced speech in 40+ languages using one of 8 preset voices. New accounts get their first short talking clip (<=5s / <=75 chars) for 0 credits in Fast Preview (~15–30s via VEED Fabric 1.0 Fast)! Subsequent or longer clips cost 12 account credits per second of speech (minimum 5s = 60 credits, maximum 30s) in Fast Preview (~15–30s) or Studio HD (~2–4 min via Kling AI Avatar v2 Standard, 720×1280 / 960×960 / 1280×720 MP4). Enqueues asynchronously and returns jobId immediately. Poll get_job for the watermark-free MP4 URL. Failed renders refund credits automatically. Requires Authorization: Bearer avs_...

assetId.description: AvatarSay character asset ID (ast_...) from generate_avatars -> get_job, import_character_portrait, or list_avatars. Camera photos of real people are not supported.

language.description: Optional language hint for pronunciation (default "auto", supporting 40+ languages): auto, English, Russian, French, Spanish, German, Arabic, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Italian, Turkish, Polish, Dutch, Hindi, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Ukrainian.

qualityMode.description: Optional render mode: "fast" (480×864 / 864×480 / 480×480, ~15–30s; required for 0-credit free trial) or "hd" (Studio HD 720×1280 / 1280×720 / 960×960, ~2–4m; default for credit-paid renders).

script.description: Spoken dialogue line in any supported language (2–400 chars, up to 30 seconds of speech; <=75 chars qualifies for the 0-credit first clip on new accounts).

voice.description: Built-in multilingual voice ID: Friendly_Person, Wise_Woman, Lively_Girl, Calm_Woman, Casual_Guy, Deep_Voice_Man, Patient_Man, Young_Knight.
